title: cedrus deodara f. robusta
intro: Cedrus deodara f. robusta, commonly known as Himalayan Deodar, is a variant of the Deodar Cedar tree, native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. It is valued for its fragrant, woody essential oil, which is rich in bioactive constituents and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Himalayan Deodar oil include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this oil include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and phenolic compounds.
